text: nice uh one thing i notice is when i turn off a layer like in here [Image #84] like i disable its visibility the whole paint on the other layer shifts and so does the text
resolution: Fixed the bug where toggling a part's visibility in the outliner shifted the paint (and stamped text) on the OTHER part. Root cause: StudioEditor passes only model.visibleParts to the viewport, and the paint atlas is packed from that set — so hiding a part shrank the pack set and re-slotted the surviving parts' UV islands (textureizeScene reassigns islands, applied back via onEditMesh), making their fixed-texture pixels sample different texels = a visible shift. Fix: pack the paint atlas over ALL parts via a new allParts prop (model.parts), so every part's UV island is invariant to which parts are currently shown. paintFaceSig, paintRepackNeeded, and ensureTexture's textureizeScene+apply all key on the full set now; the visible set still drives render/hit-test/paint targeting. Verified: hmsc-int bundles clean (real esbuild flags), meshPaint suite 15/15. Note: the standalone Studio.tsx route has a pre-existing duplicate viewport that didn't get this (or the text/lock-face work); the user is on the studiokit/workbench path which is fixed.
